args.title: Brightline Cold-Chain Summary (main + companion)
args.body:
Combined three-bullet summary of Brightline's cold-chain logistics pieces (blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain and its companion at insights.brightline.example):

- Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than from less spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilot programs cut insurance claims by about a quarter (25%).

Note: companion piece required email registration; accessed using priya.adeyemi@northwind.example with Priya's explicit permission.
